text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
—For this year's "Osaka Hai", McQueen's main target
might be the "Tenno Sho (Spring)", but still...
She's definitely gonna deliver in the "Osaka Hai" too!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Her run in the Kikuka Sho was amazing, after all.
I'd love to see her show off her strength in medium distance too~!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Because I have been looking forward to it.
To taking on this Osaka Hai.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: ...To be able to compete with McQueen-san.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro McQueen's growth rate was,
to put it frankly... extraordinary.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "According to IRON WILL's analysis, her racing ability growth since the Kikuka Sho easily exceeds double our initial projections."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"It is certainly no exaggeration to say that Mejiro McQueen
is the strongest horse girl of Ikuno Dictus's generation right now."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: "I believe IRON WILL's evaluation of McQueen is extremely accurate."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: ...Because I know.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
—That she was continually
putting in extraordinary effort.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Without letting her guard down after winning the Kikuka Sho,
she had instead pushed herself even further into a corner—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: “...You wish to learn management techniques from me?”

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: "Yes. I wish to gain more knowledge and perspective in order to become even a little bit stronger than I am now."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"‘...My management and maintenance may clash with the policies of the Mejiro family.
Are you still certain about this?’"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"There is no need to worry.
I will make whatever I am taught my own, and utilize it in the most optimal way."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"Turning everything into your power...
Isn't that what true strength is, too?"

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: "...It is just as you say."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: —And so, McQueen absorbed everything around her, combining it with the strength of the Mejiro family to forge her own power.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Her greed simply manifested in the results.
...I believe that is the most accurate,
straightforward assessment.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Yet on the other hand, there was another Umamusume who was achieving the same extraordinary growth as Mejiro McQueen—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —That would be Ikuno Dictus herself.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: According to IRON WILL's evaluation, she too was exhibiting growth in racing ability far beyond that of an average Umamusume—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Competing against Mejiro McQueen in the Spring Senior Triple Crown might lead Ikuno Dictus's potential to even greater heights...!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Fufu—
It seems Trainer is looking forward
to our battle as well.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...For two who took different paths in their Classic Year
to clash for supremacy like this in the Senior Year—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"This is a sight we can only witness because both of them ran their hardest and made it here today in top form.
Right now, I just want to savor this joy...!"
choice_data_list: Let's show them what you're made of.
Let's show them what you're really made of.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Yes...!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Well then, I'll go tie them together.
My hoofprints, and McQueen-san's—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
(—The air is heavy.
And yet... faintly hot.)

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: (So this is the pressure of a Senior Class race—)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: —It truly is delightful, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
It feels as though everyone's fighting spirits
are sharpening one another.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: McQueen-san—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
(She truly is... completely different from usual.
So this is McQueen-san in a race—)

text_block_list.name: Racing Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
"Did she really just enter the Senior Division...?
You've gotta be kidding me...!"

text_block_list.name: Racing Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
"...I can't see the bottom.
How scary, how scary...—"

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: ...Let's make it a good race.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Yes. Let us make it a splendid opening act.
